name: prometheus.exporter.postgres

arguments.name: data_source_names
arguments.description: Specifies the PostgreSQL servers to connect to.

arguments.name: custom_queries_config_path
arguments.description: Path to YAML file containing custom queries to expose as metrics.

arguments.name: disable_default_metrics
arguments.description: When true, only exposes metrics supplied from custom_queries_config_path.

arguments.name: disable_settings_metrics
arguments.description: Disables collection of metrics from pg_settings.

arguments.name: enabled_collectors
arguments.description: List of collectors to enable. Refer to the information below for more detail.

exported_fields.name: targets
exported_fields.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.

data_source_names.description: Specifies the PostgreSQL servers to connect to.

custom_queries_config_path.description: Path to YAML file containing custom queries to expose as metrics.

disable_default_metrics.description: When true, only exposes metrics supplied from custom_queries_config_path.

disable_settings_metrics.description: Disables collection of metrics from pg_settings.

enabled_collectors.description: List of collectors to enable. Refer to the information below for more detail.

arguments.name: database_allowlist
arguments.description: List of databases to filter for, meaning only these databases will be scraped.

arguments.name: database_denylist
arguments.description: List of databases to filter out, meaning all other databases will be scraped.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.description: Whether to automatically discover other databases.

targets.description: The targets that can be used to collect exporter metrics.
